name: SweetCanvas
source:
Yoshiya Isa, a third year transfer student from the rural southern edge of the Eastern Province, finds himself hopelessly lost on the first day of the second semester. 

Unable to rely on his phone due to it inexplicably not having charged the night before, and finding it more difficult than he had anticipated to get any of the busy city folk to stop and give him directions, he's starting to think that it might be best to just accept the fact that he'll be late on his first day and take the train back to his apartment.

As he's just about to give up however, he spots what might be his only saving grace: a girl wandering the streets wearing a high school uniform! Realizing that she's his best bet at finally getting some directions, he decides that this time he won't take no for an answer- but to his surprise, she suddenly locks eyes with him before he can even call out to her.

"...You're not from around here!"

"I can tell from that look on your face that you must be lost. I can help you!"

Little does Isa know that this chance meeting- this one genuine coincidence, will completely change how the story of his life unfolds from this point onwards! 

Love, friendship, occult phenomena- In the face of supernatural entities, long forgotten secrets, and most pressingly: his potential partner's parents... will Isa be able to untangle this web of interconnected fates and find romance in the process?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gloss/sweetcanvas-a-monster-girl-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
Yoshiya Isa是来自东部省南部边缘农村的三年级转学生，他在第二学期的第一天发现自己绝望地迷失了方向。

由于手机前一天晚上莫名其妙地没有充电，他无法依赖手机，而且他发现让忙碌的城市居民停下来给他指路比他预想的要困难，他开始认为最好接受他第一天会迟到的事实，然后乘火车回到自己的公寓。

然而，正当他准备放弃时，他发现了可能是他唯一的可取之处：一个穿着高中制服在街上闲逛的女孩！意识到她是他最终获得​​指示的最佳选择，他决定这一次他不会拒绝——但令他惊讶的是，在他还没来得及叫她之前，她突然与他对视。

“……你不是这附近的人！”

“我看你的表情就知道你一定是迷路了，我可以帮你！”

伊莎不知道，这次偶遇——这一次真正的巧合，将彻底改变他人生故事从此展开的方式！

爱情、友谊、神秘现象——面对超自然实体、早已被遗忘的秘密，以及最紧迫的：他潜在伴侣的父母……伊莎能否解开这张相互关联的命运之网，并在此过程中找到浪漫？
